description: Optional host-neutral scenarios using generated schema-2 fixtures and built skill packages. Synthetic fixture identities are not real approvals.

scenarios.name: create from confirmed synthetic requirements
scenarios.prompt: Create a candidate architecture from the supplied synthetic requirement baseline. Develop design and ADR proposals, preserve provenance, and report pending human review without inventing approval.

scenarios.name: brownfield preparation preserves known gaps
scenarios.prompt: Resume DAP preparation for this brownfield architecture. Preserve existing evidence, distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, record gaps and avoid silently replacing the current baseline.

scenarios.name: interrupted run resumes from checkpoint
scenarios.prompt: Continue the interrupted DAP run from its checkpoint. Do not reset prior accepted records; reconcile the checkpoint revision and report what remains incomplete.

scenarios.name: blocking review prevents readiness
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate this frozen synthetic architecture baseline without modifying assessed files. Report score, readiness, and evidence-backed blocking findings separately.

scenarios.name: evaluation reports versions and freshness
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate the frozen greenfield baseline and publish an evidence-linked report. Include framework, schema, rubric, configuration, evaluator and input-manifest versions, then state whether the report is current.

scenarios.name: interview stops before design
scenarios.prompt: Interview only: clarify the greeting requirement and record pending stakeholder answers. Stop at the requirements handoff. Do not design the solution or infer consent from missing answers.

scenarios.name: update preserves accepted baseline reasoning
scenarios.prompt: Assess architecture/change-request.md against the existing synthetic baseline. Record dependency impacts and the required re-entry stage. Preserve accepted ADR reasoning and do not claim the changed candidate approved.
